name: student-illustrator-scoreboard
exporter: Adobe Illustrator 28.6 - Export As > SVG, Styling: Internal CSS, Responsive on
story: A media student drew the floorball scorebug their class runs on Friday: a strip across the top with the two club names, the two goal figures, the period underneath, and a red MAALI! flash they switched off in the layers panel because they only want it up for a second. They named their layers for themselves - Home, Away, Home goals, Away goals, Period, Goal - having read nothing about NoaCG, and exported with Illustrator's dialog untouched, so Responsive stayed ticked and the file carries a viewBox and no width or height.
idioms: Generator comment naming the SVG Export Plug-In build
version="1.1" id="Layer_1" with x="0px" y="0px" and xml:space="preserve" on tab-indented continuation lines
Responsive export: viewBox only, no width/height attributes
<style type="text/css"> holding one property per .stN class, uppercase hex
point type as <text transform="matrix(1 0 0 1 x y)"> with the class list carrying fill, family and size separately
_x20_ escapes with data-name on the layers the student named, and no id at all on the two club-name texts
a hidden layer exported as class="st12" whose rule is display:none - Illustrator's shape for an eye switched off
tab indentation, one tab per nesting level
whyThisMatters: This is one of the two graphics the 2026-09-12 production ships, drawn by the person who will run it. Three promises meet in it. docs/SVG_AUTHORING.md section 2 says the artwork's own size drives the graphic, and a Responsive export states that size only in the viewBox. Section 3 says a plain figure proposes a number field, which is the whole reason an operator gets a plus/minus stepper without anybody writing code - so both goal figures must arrive as numbers, and the two unnamed club-name texts must still get a readable label from the group around them. Section 5b says a switched-off layer is kept as a drawn moment rather than dropped, and Illustrator writes that switch as a display:none CLASS, not an attribute or an inline style - an importer that only reads the attribute form loses the goal flash silently.
